title: Besicovitch–Vitali cover of E by disjoint admissible closed balls inside an open set
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → ℝ → Prop) (E W : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → IsOpen W → E ⊆ W → (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < δ ∧ Q x ρ) → ∃ (t : Set (Euclid P)) (r : Euclid P → ℝ), t.Countable ∧ t ⊆ E ∧ (∀ x ∈ t, 0 < r x ∧ closedBall x (r x) ⊆ W ∧ Q x (r x)) ∧ t.PairwiseDisjoint (fun x => closedBall x (r x)) ∧ μ (E \ ⋃ x ∈ t, closedBall x (r x)) = 0
